sources.snippet: DreamFast/gemma-3-12b-it-heretic-v2 is an abliterated version of Google's Gemma 3 12B IT model, created using Heretic v1.3.0. This model significantly reduces refusals while maintaining quality, making it suitable as an uncensored text encoder for video generation models like LTX-2.
